title.narrative: Facilitation and Coordination of access for humanitarian goods and personnel

description.narrative: This activity Facilitation and Coordination of access for humanitarian goods and personnel is a component of Assistance to United Nations Access Coordination Unit in the Occupied Palestinian Territories. reported by FCDO with a funding type of 105 - Humanitarian assistance and a budget of £1,927,677. It works in the following sector(s): Relief co-ordination and support services.
